Evidence: normalized Python AST/runtime trees match after replacing only the 31 owned leading docstrings; all protected docstrings/comments, inline comments, directive-bearing lines, and the owned comment attachment are exact. Parent and frozen base are byte-identical for all 18 owned paths. The changed-path set is exactly those 18 paths. Focused consumers: 167 passed, 6 skipped. Scoped Ruff and format-check, comment hygiene, diff integrity, and commit-ticket verification passed. DCO and Gerrit Change-Id are present.

Independent word census using the frozen-ticket word rule: 3069 -> 1369 (1700 removed). This corrects the implementation handoff's non-blocking 1,341 total; the immutable commit measures 1,369. Every row remains strictly shorter.
